name: Camping Biberhof
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Biberhof is located in the municipality of Biberwier in the Tiroler district of Reutte. The surroundings are characterized by the mountain landscape of the Zugspitze Arena. Hiking trails and cycling trails are available nearby. In winter, the ski areas Zugspitze and Ehrwalder Alm can be reached quickly. The site is designed to be close to nature and quiet. The facilities include pitches for tents and motorhomes as well as sanitary facilities. Guests can expect a simple and functional offering for a stay in nature.
